text:
HELICANUS:
  How dare the plants look up to heaven,
  when heaven is where their nourishment comes from?
PERICLES:
  You know I have the power to take your life.
  (Helicanus kneels and answers.)
  I've sharpened the axe myself.
  All you have to do is strike.
PERICLES:
  Get up, please, get up.
  Sit down. You're no flatterer, and I thank you for it.
  God forbid a king should let his faults be hidden from his ears!
  You're the right counsellor and servant for a prince.
  Your wisdom makes the prince your servant.
  What do you want me to do?
